To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) MFSs are a new structural concept for metalloproteomics; (ii) MFSs can help to understand the functional role of metal ions in proteins, and (iii) MFSs may serve as a new type of structural motif to study the structural and functional evolution of metalloproteomes.

MFSs can serve as a structural and functional signature for the metal ion in a macromolecule, they can be used for the detection of metal-binding sites in protein sequences, they provide a tool to analyze and compare metalloproteomes, and they can be applied to the detection of metalloproteome evolution.
